note.zh: 10010：通过15天后发给所有成员，告知可劝失业者志愿迁居；10210：立即发给处于违规（分层经济生活水准或牲畜/奴隶/电网融合奴役）的成员国。
note.en: 10010: sent to all members 15 days after passing, announcing voluntary resettlement of the unemployed; 10210: sent at once to members in breach (Stratified Economy, or chattel / livestock / grid amalgamation slavery).

scope.zh: 决议“超越自我”：福利窗口（10010）与违规窗口（10210）。
scope.en: The resolution "Greater Than Ourselves": the benefit window (10010) and the breach window (10210).
